Help.title: Help
Help.subtitle: Most questions are already answered below.
Help.still_stuck: Still can't find what you need?
Help.a_what: Movy is a browsing front-end for movies, series and anime. It shows artwork, ratings, cast and release calendars pulled from TMDB, and ships a player shell you can connect to your own licensed sources.
Help.a_host: No. This project ships without any stream providers. The player shows the official trailer until you configure a source of your own.
Help.q_servers: What is the server picker for?
Help.a_servers: When you register one or more playback providers, each one appears as a server in the player so viewers can switch between them.
Help.q_quality: Why does a title have no trailer?
Help.a_quality: Trailers come from TMDB's video listings. If nobody has added one for a title yet, the player falls back to the backdrop art.
Help.a_profiles: Profiles, the watchlist and your history are stored in this browser only. Clearing site data removes them. Nothing is sent to a server.
Help.a_sync: Not out of the box. The storage layer is a small module you can point at any backend.
Help.a_party: The lobby and room screens are fully built, but rooms are local to this browser until you connect a realtime service.
Help.q_data: Where does the data come from?
Help.a_data: All metadata and images come from The Movie Database (TMDB). This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
Help.q_remove: How do I report a problem with a title?
Help.a_remove: Use the contact details on the DMCA page. Catalog corrections should go to TMDB directly, since that is where the data is maintained.

Legal.contact_hint: Questions about this page? Reach the maintainers through the repository's issue tracker.
